column2: Prepare the test sheet with the limits for this model before the visit
Check meter and safety analyser calibration dates
Make as-found measurements before cleaning or adjusting
Test every safety function, including warning lights and emergency stops
Measure kV, time, reproducibility, linearity, output and HVL; fluoroscopy dose rates and timer where relevant
Check light field against X-ray field, centring, distance indicator, automatic collimation, AEC
Run phantom images with the baseline setup; save images and settings
Finish with IEC 62353 electrical safety testing and a report with a clear fitness-for-use statement
